notes.title: V23 - Housekeeping update
notes.notes:
[h2]V23 - Housekeeping update[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added an OLED button in video options that allows you to turn the greyish background off and make it true black (requested)
[*] Improved ammo pickup slightly, now when its really close itll zip towards you and be collected. I would see people in videos playing and being frustrated when they flew past an ammo and didnt get it (not fun).
[*] Resolved the broken Full Steam Leaderboards button
[*] Resolved crash on exit on Mac
[*] Now fully working on Linux (sorry about that)
[*] Full Steamdeck support confirmed
[*] Proper Cloud saving Cross-Platform Win/Mac/Lin (visual and certain options will not sync, but progress and scores)
[*] Updated store page and features where appropriate
[*] Changed share button to now copy message/score to clipboard so you can use it anywhere instead of opening up a direct link to Twitter
[*] Decreased install size
[*] Updated the Unity backend
[*] Migrating save files (copying not deleting so old one is still there if something goes wrong) from old versions to new save location to be consistent with all my games.
[*] Removed additional exit menu and videos. 
[*] Added unified Update text and "More Games By" panel on main menu that will be in all my games going forward. If you click the panel it will open to the games page and then won't suggest that game again on this installation. Also allows me to push update text without a full game update in case of urgent issues. 
[*] Probably other minor fixes I forgot (sorry)
[/list]

Hotfix 2025-03-15 - V21 Resolved Simplified Chinese text not appearing correctly on SteamOS + Linux
Hotfix 2025-03-16 - V23 Pushed improvements to various translations (still not perfect I know)

Thanks yall, let me know if I missed anything or you hit problems :)
adamvision <3

notes.title: Ding Dong XL Version 7 Update
notes.notes:
A new challenge awaits you in the brand new game changing Infinite Mode! Improved graphics, better balance, and many more additions and changes. Check out Ding Dong XL V7 now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32763348/a4d869a960a2e0915114ecc60bc25c23a3a4f052.gif[/img]

Patch Notes: (additional leader boards + online for switch)
[list][*] New Infinite play mode added
[*] New Unlock-able Space Rocks skin
[*] Bonus Points power-up is now worth 5 Points
[*] Added Bit Blaster, Orbt, and Diamo songs for each of the special characters
[*] When you're stationary with a time slow power-up, the growth of the ball will stop completely
[*] Early button presses after death will not be erroneously detected
[*] Power-up timers correctly reset when dying and restarting they now also disappear upon death 
[*] Pink enemy now correctly has it's trail fade in/out with the rest of the enemy
[*] Modified and added some little secrets here and there
[*] Re-balanced some late game elements to ensure there are always viable paths to take and made 250+ not dependent on power-ups
[*] Player can now remain idle slightly longer before exploding
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the latest update, and if you do, make sure to leave a Steam review and share the game with your friends. Thanks for the continued support of my games. 

-Adam Nickerson ([url=https://twitter.com/nickervision]@nickervision[/url])


[h1]Don't forget to also add Super Bit Blaster XL to your Steam Wishlist![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/865040/Super_Bit_Blaster_XL/

notes.title: ★ Update from the Developer ★
notes.notes:
[h1][b]To my fellow Bit Blasters![/b][/h1]

First of all, I'd like to say a big [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone that has played, shared, supported and rated Bit Blaster XL since its release on Steam in January. It really means a lot to me as a solo, still learning developer that so many people are enjoying my game. Thank you so so much!

I just wanted to put a couple bullet points out there to express some amazing (or at least I think so) facts and milestones in Bit Blaster XL's journey over its first five months on Steam.
[list]
[*][b]40,000+[/b] players worldwide (that's crazy to me)
[*][b]99% Overwhelmingly Positive[/b] review status on Steam, sometimes even topping out as the highest on average reviewed title available on the Steam platform (this is thanks to everyone's constant kind words and awesome reviews)
[*]Many patches and hot fixes since release, including everything from bug fixes, new modes (manual fire), leader boards, more achievements, new ships to unlock, new power ups, new enemies, new music, rewritten movement system, and many other significant graphical and game play improvements
[*]An incredibly helpful and active community helping me track down every last bug and issue in the game as well as suggest great new features and improvements to add
[*]A huge amount of wicked posts, comments and articles on many press sites, Reddit and Twitter
[/list]
Over the last month or so I have been focusing mostly on my day job (I am a self employed IT guy) while keeping an eye on Bit Blaster XL forums to ensure anyone having a problem could get some help. I recently bought my first Condo with my GF and moved/set up my office at my new home. Here is a little preview of my modest space...[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11525962/6c1be67cf5df3c4aa6479950d7afd9f8aefce64b.jpg[/img] I still have yet to hang my last few posters (waiting for my HL2 one to finish being framed). I also needed to make some time to play some new games, Stardew Valley (basically my dream game when I was growing up), Uncharted 4 (was a stellar conclusion), and even toying around with my new HTC Vive and a variety of the software that comes with that (check out Job Simulator, The Lab, and Space Pirate Trainer)

Now that I am settled in at my new place (mostly) I am ready to get back to working on the next significant patch for Bit Blaster XL. I wanted to keep everyone in the loop so that you all know I am still around and reading your ideas and suggestions and taking notes all while doing the best I can to provide customer support to anyone having issues. I don't yet have a date for when I will be releasing the next patch, as I intend to take my time and look harder into some things that have really confounded me in the past. 

I can offer no guarantees for what will or won't make it into the patch, but I am certainly looking hard at things suggested to me by the community including;
[list]
[*]Pause system
[*]Static backgrounds to liven up the environment, without impacting the play
[*]Steam cloud for saves
[*]In-game resolution and windowed mode options
[/list]
Please keep in mind, I am just learning as I go, so I cannot promise these will ever actually make it in, just know that I am going to do my damndest to look into implementing them if I can.

On top of those things above, I have my own list of changes / additions I will be making (ones I know for sure I can code) These changes include things like; an entirely new mode, additional underlying systems of game play to add more strategy to the experience (while still being able to play exactly how you do now too if you want), along with some great small fixes, graphical additions and game play enhancements.

I just want to say [b]thank you[/b] again for all the support so far. Hopefully Bit Blaster XL can continue to make an impact with players looking for a fun retro arcade game experience. I hope that this eventually turns into me being able to work on games as my day job instead of it just a hobby. I can only imagine the things I could learn and create with the extra time, especially with an awesome community like you all offering feedback along the way.

Oh also, [b]Bit Blaster XL will be on the week long sale on Steam starting next Monday for 50% off[/b], that's as low as $0.49 cents in many markets, so selling the trading cards will literally(probably) pay you back. Please don't hesitate to share Bit Blaster XL with your friends and family, your favorite press sites and Youtubers, or leave a brief review on Steam if you have yet to do so, letting others know what you like about it. It all really helps me to continue to make games and make them the best I can.

Adam Nickerson
[url=http://www.nickervisionstudios.com]Nickervision Studios[/url]
[url=http://www.twitter.com/nickervision]Follow me On Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Bit Blaster XL V1.30 BETA patch
notes.notes:
I would greatly appreciate if a variety of players could test it out and leave feedback in a comment below on whether or not it worked for them.

[h1]To try out the BETA version;[/h1]
[i]--> Right click the game in the library tab
--> Click Properties
--> Click the BETAS tab
--> From the Drop down box select the Testing beta
--> Click close[/i] 

The beta should then automatically download. Make sure that if the BETA doesn't work for you, you use the same method to turn it off.

[h1]Some of the fixes include:[/h1]
[b]-->  [/b]Added a V-sync button in the options menu
[b]-->  [/b]A couple new achievements
[b]-->  [/b]Various GFX and colliders modifications on weapons, making them feel better and more effective.
[b]-->  [/b]Several more changes to be detailed in patch notes when live.

Thank you to everyone for playing and offering feedback and leaving great reviews. [b]Please continue to share Bit Blaster XL with friends and family[/b], I greatly appreciate it.

Adam Nickerson
[url=https://twitter.com/nickervision]Nickervision Studios[/url]

notes.title: Bit Blaster XL V1.10 BETA Patch
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

I just wanted to send through an announcement of the V1.1 BETA patch now being available in the BETA branch for Win32, Win64, Linux32, Linux64, OSX.

It features a variety of fixes and improvements. I would love if some players could test it out and let me know that it works. If you do test it, please leave feedback in a comment below (good or bad) with whatever important/unique details you can provide about your machine (Operating system, 32 or 64 bits, 60hz, 120hz, etc)

To try out the BETA version of Bit Blaster XL V1.1, just [b]right click the game in the library tab. --> Click Properties --> Click the BETAS tab --> from the Drop down box select the Testing beta.[/b]  It should then automatically download. Make sure that if the BETA doesn't work for you, you use the same method to turn it off.

[b]Some of the fixes include:[/b]
-All Objects should now move at the same speed regardless of framerate
-Super fast gameplay and super slow gameplay should now be resolved
-Heatseeker should work great now
-Fully rewritten shield system, should be far more stable and allow for a couple upcoming features
-Mouse cursor should now disappear correctly during a round of play and reappear in menus.
-Slightly adjusted colors here and there, and modified various GUI details ever so slightly. 
-And a variety of other small changes. 

Of course I don't want to push this until I have a good handful of people from a variety of machines telling me its working great. Many people have shared videos with me too and that's always very helpful as well, send them to info(at)nickervision(dot)com

And lastly, thank you to everyone that has been playing so far, left great reviews, and share Bit Blaster XL with their friends and family. This launch week has far exceeded my expectations and it feels great to be embraced by such an awesome community. [b]Thanks so so much.[/b]

-Adam Nickerson
